summary: One test failed due to a timeout waiting for a page element to be clickable, causing the overall execution to fail.
rootCause: The test timed out waiting for the locator '[data-test="nav-hand-tools"]' to be available for clicking, indicating the selector did not match any element or the element was not present/visible in time.

failedTests.testName: TC-001 - Verify category page displays the correct products and title
failedTests.errorMessage: Test timeout of 30000ms exceeded while waiting for locator('[data-test="nav-hand-tools"]') to be clickable.
failedTests.likelyCause: Selector '[data-test="nav-hand-tools"]' did not match any visible element on the page within the timeout period.
failedTests.recommendation: Verify that the selector '[data-test="nav-hand-tools"]' is correct and that the element is present and visible on the page at the time of the click. Consider adding waits or checking for page readiness before clicking.

recommendations: Review and validate the selector '[data-test="nav-hand-tools"]' in the application UI.
Add explicit waits or assertions to ensure the page and elements are fully loaded before interaction.
Check if recent application changes affected the presence or attributes of the targeted element.
If the element is dynamically loaded, increase timeout or use waitForSelector before clicking.
releaseImpact: High - The failure blocks the verification of critical category page functionality, impacting release confidence.
